(Sections with * are likely to differ from partner to partner, so please ensure they represent your process) Just getting started on Recruitment? Complete these five simple steps to get ready to post your first job: 1. Create your Privacy Policy Candidates are required to accept your privacy policy when they apply to one of your roles to ensure compliance with GDPR. To generate a policy for your company, go to Settings - Data & Privacy - Privacy Policy . For more details on creating your privacy policy, please review our guide. 2. Add team members and manage their permission levels* Managing access to Recruitment is possible from within the HRIS core platform. <Customise as required from HRIS .> For more details on managing team member access, take a look at our guide on managing users. You can also find a breakdown of permission levels. 3. Set Up Integrations Our calendar integration, Cronofy, allows you to automate interview scheduling through Recruitment . By allowing access to your calendar availability, Recruitment can offer available slots to candidates to self-schedule interviews, saving you lots of valuable time. You can set this up under Settings - Integrations - My Integrations - Automatic Interview Scheduling - Cronofy . Note: if you are syncing with a work Microsoft calendar, you are likely to need to use Office365 to authenticate your account. You can set your diary availability under Settings - Personal - My Preferences . Integrating your email allows you to communicate with candidates through the platform through your own email address. We integrate with both Google and Microsoft. You can set this up under Settings - Integrations - My Integrations - Email Candidates . Note: if you are using your business Microsoft account, it’s likely you need to select Office365 to complete your authentication after selecting “Connect” on the Microsoft button. 4. Set Up Your Career site Simployer Recruitment enables you to set up a Career Page quickly and easily, helping you promote your Employer Value Proposition and greatly increase candidate interest in working for your business. If you are creating your career page for the first time in Simployer Recruitment , head to Settings - Career Site - Customise to get started. Click on the Setting wheel to get started. If you are looking to integrate your existing career page with Recruitment , you can head to Settings - Career Site - Customise to find your iFrame code. Take a look at our guides here for more detail. We also enable an API integration, should you wish to expore that. This is available via Settings – Integrations – Jobs API. Note: you may need support from an IT contact within your organisation to get this integration up and running. 5. Create your first job You're now ready to set your first job live! Go to the Jobs section on the navigations bar, and select Add New Job . You’ll be taken through a 6 step process to get your job live: Job Details: job description, salary, location and job advert Job Options: screening questions, blind hiring, candidate match score, job access and notifications Interview Stages: select the number and type of interviews you’ll be having Interview Details: add your hiring team and set up any automations you wish to use (such as interview scheduling) Scorecards: select the skills, values and competencies you wish to evaluate the candidates against for this job Share: advertise your job through socials channels and job To read more about Simployer HRM Api Klick here Was this article helpful? You can set your diary availability underSettings - Personal - My Preferences.

            Simployer One - Recruitment - Getting started

            Modified on Wed, 27 Aug at 1:16 PM

            Getting started

            Five easy steps to get ready to post your first job. (Sections with * are likely to differ from partner to partner, so please ensure they represent your process)

            Just getting started on Recruitment? Complete these five simple steps to get ready to post your first job:

            1. Create your Privacy Policy

            Candidates are required to accept your privacy policy when they apply to one of your roles to ensure compliance with GDPR.

            To generate a policy for your company, go to Settings - Data & Privacy - Privacy Policy.

            For more details on creating your privacy policy, please review our guide.

            2. Add team members and manage their permission levels*

            Managing access to Recruitment is possible from within the HRIS core platform. <Customise as required from HRIS.>

            For more details on managing team member access, take a look at our guide on managing users. You can also find a breakdown of permission levels.

            3. Set Up Integrations 

            Our calendar integration, Cronofy, allows you to automate interview scheduling through Recruitment. By allowing access to your calendar availability, Recruitment can offer available slots to candidates to self-schedule interviews, saving you lots of valuable time. You can set this up under Settings - Integrations - My Integrations - Automatic Interview Scheduling - Cronofy.


            Note: if you are syncing with a work Microsoft calendar, you are likely to need to use Office365 to authenticate your account.


            You can set your diary availability under Settings - Personal - My Preferences.



            Integrating your email allows you to communicate with candidates through the platform through your own email address. We integrate with both Google and Microsoft. You can set this up under Settings - Integrations - My Integrations - Email Candidates. 


             

            Note: if you are using your business Microsoft account, it’s likely you need to select Office365 to complete your authentication after selecting “Connect” on the Microsoft button.

             

            4. Set Up Your Career site

            Simployer Recruitment enables you to set up a Career Page quickly and easily, helping you promote your Employer Value Proposition and greatly increase candidate interest in working for your business. 

            If you are creating your career page for the first time in Simployer Recruitment, head to Settings - Career Site - Customise to get started. Click on the Setting wheel to get started.

            If you are looking to integrate your existing career page with Recruitment , you can head to Settings - Career Site - Customise to find your iFrame code. Take a look at our guides here for more detail. We also enable an API integration, should you wish to expore that. This is available via Settings – Integrations – Jobs API.

            Note: you may need support from an IT contact within your organisation to get this integration up and running. 

             

            5. Create your first job

            You're now ready to set your first job live!

            Go to the Jobs section on the navigations bar, and select Add New Job. You’ll be taken through a 6 step process to get your job live:

            • Job Details: job description, salary, location and job advert 
            • Job Options: screening questions, blind hiring, candidate match score, job access and notifications
            • Interview Stages: select the number and type of interviews you’ll be having
            • Interview Details: add your hiring team and set up any automations you wish to use (such as interview scheduling)
            • Scorecards: select the skills, values and competencies you wish to evaluate the candidates against for this job
            • Share: advertise your job through socials channels and job 

            To read more about Simployer HRM Api Klick here

Importing candidates
How to import candidates into yourRecruitmentdatabase
Note:Candidates that have already been imported toRecruitmentwill be flagged as duplicates – email is the unique identifier.
Adding individual candidates
You can add candidates intoRecruitmentby clicking the pink '+' at the top right of most pages.
This will allow you to upload the candidate's CV, fill out their details, and also link them to an existing job, if required.
Bulk importing candidates
To import multiple candidates at once, head to theCandidates tab - Import Candidates - Bulk Import.
The bulk import can be done either by uploading a .zip folder of CVs, or by multi-selecting CVs in the dialogue box.

Note: When using the folder upload, your.zip file must be under 5mb. When using the mutli-select, your files must be under 10mb, with a maximum of 25 files. The files must be in a .pdf, .doc or .docx format.

            Importing candidates

            How to import candidates into your Recruitment database

            Note: Candidates that have already been imported to Recruitment will be flagged as duplicates – email is the unique identifier.

            Adding individual candidates

            You can add candidates into Recruitment by clicking the pink '+' at the top right of most pages.

            This will allow you to upload the candidate's CV, fill out their details, and also link them to an existing job, if required.

             

            Bulk importing candidates

            To import multiple candidates at once, head to the Candidates tab - Import Candidates - Bulk Import.

            The bulk import can be done either by uploading a .zip folder of CVs, or by multi-selecting CVs in the dialogue box.

             

            Note: When using the folder upload, your .zip file must be under 5mb. When using the mutli-select, your files must be under 10mb, with a maximum of 25 files. The files must be in a .pdf, .doc or .docx format.

You can add your font colour and logo to customise the branding on emails, ensuring your messaging feels on-brand to candidates. Uploading your logos You can add two logos on Recruitment - your main brand logo, and your email logo. Head to Settings - Company - Profile to upload these. Your brand logo will appear at the top left of your application page for your jobs, as highlighted here in the red box: Your email logo will appear at the bottom of the emails sent to candidates.             Simployer One - Recruitment - Customise your company branding

            Modified on Mon, 23 Jun at 10:54 AM

            Customise your company branding

            Set up your branding elements to personalise your Recruitment account.

            You can add your font colour and logo to customise the branding on emails, ensuring your messaging feels on-brand to candidates.

            Uploading your logos

            You can add two logos on Recruitment - your main brand logo, and your email logo. Head to Settings - Company - Profile to upload these.

            Your brand logo will appear at the top left of your application page for your jobs, as highlighted here in the red box:

            Your email logo will appear at the bottom of the emails sent to candidates.

             

            Notes on formatting:

            • Your brand logo dimensions should be 184px by 50px. The max file size is 200kb. The format should be .png with a transparent background.
            • Your email logo should be 365px by 120px. The max file size is 100kb. The format should be .png. The email footer's colour is fixed to be white, and you can include a coloured or black logo for it to stand out.

            Customising your font colour

            You can also customise your brand colour, which will be used on the application page for your jobs. This can be changed under Settings - Company - Profile - Brand Colour.

For example, you will be notified if: An interview has been scheduled, rescheduled or cancelled You’ve been added as an interviewer for a job A job or offer has been approved It’s time to fill out an interview scorecard Your job hasn’t progressed for 7 days How to integrate Slack with Recruitment : Click on Settings – Integrations – My Integrations Click the “Connect” button next to Slack You will be directed through to slack.com/workspace-signin page Follow the prompts to authorise the integration When the integration is successful, you will receive a message to confirm that it’s activated. Note: You are unable to integrate Slack if your access level is Reviewer. Speak to your Account Owner to upgrade your access level if you believe this is something you need. How to update your Notifications for Slack: Navigate to Settings – Personal – My Notifications In the top right hand side, click the “ALERTS” tab Check or uncheck the options for the Slack platform to customise notifications Was this article helpful?             Connecting to Slack

            Recruitment has an integration with Slack that allows you to receive notifications in Slack about key events related to your job and to remind you to take an action if desired.
             
             For example, you will be notified if:

            • An interview has been scheduled, rescheduled or cancelled
            • You’ve been added as an interviewer for a job
            • A job or offer has been approved
            • It’s time to fill out an interview scorecard
            • Your job hasn’t progressed for 7 days 

             

            How to integrate Slack with Recruitment  : 

            1. Click on Settings – Integrations – My Integrations
            2. Click the “Connect” button next to Slack
            3. You will be directed through to slack.com/workspace-signin page
            4. Follow the prompts to authorise the integration

            When the integration is successful, you will receive a message to confirm that it’s activated.

            Note: You are unable to integrate Slack if your access level is Reviewer. Speak to your Account Owner to upgrade your access level if you believe this is something you need.


            How to update your Notifications for Slack:

            1. Navigate to Settings – Personal – My Notifications 
            2. In the top right hand side, click the “ALERTS” tab
            3. Check or uncheck the options for the Slack platform to customise notifications

All Articles Recent Searches Clear all No recent searches Popular Articles Articles View all Topics View all Tickets View all Sorry! nothing found for Simployer One - Recruitment - Connecting Cronofy to Recruitment Modified on Mon, 23 Jun at 10:52 AM Connecting Cronofy to Recruitment Simployer Recruitment`s interview scheduling allows you to automate the scheduling of interviews, offering candidates a 1-1 interview, either by phone, video or in-person, or supporting panel style interviews with multiple client-side attendees, or sequential interviews where multiple interviewers take part in a single interview stage as different times, eg ‘Hiring Manager A’ doing 30-mins followed by 45-mins with ‘Hiring Manager B’. The first thing to do to enable automated interview scheduling is to connect to Cronofy, our API which enables us to gather your live calendar availability. To set this up, head to Settings - Integrations - My Integrations . Then, find Cronofy and click Connect . You will be prompted to integrate your individual work email account. You will receive a success message, and the button with show as “Disconnect” once the integration is complete. Note: we do not support integration with shared inboxes through Cronofy as this integration requires a personal calendar to be available to select slots from. Note : If your company uses Microsoft for business, the highest likelihood is that you have Microsoft 365 – please ensure you select Office 365 from the Cronofy options, not Outlook.com, for example. Once you have integrated your calendar, you can set your availability for interviews  by going to Settings – Personal – My Preferences. Here you can select your date format, time zone and the days and hours that you wish to be available for interview, in conjunction with your live calendar availability Was this article helpful? Connecting Cronofy toRecruitment

Simployer Recruitment`s interview scheduling allows you to automate the scheduling of interviews, offering candidates a 1-1 interview, either by phone, video or in-person, or supporting panel style interviews with multiple client-side attendees, or sequential interviews where multiple interviewers take part in a single interview stage as different times, eg ‘Hiring Manager A’ doing 30-mins followed by 45-mins with ‘Hiring Manager B’.
The first thing to do to enable automated interview scheduling is to connect to Cronofy, our API which enables us to gather your live calendar availability.
To set this up, head toSettings - Integrations - My Integrations.

Then, findCronofyand clickConnect. You will be prompted to integrate your individual work email account. You will receive a success message, and the button with show as “Disconnect” once the integration is complete.
Note:we do not support integration with shared inboxes through Cronofy as this integration requires a personal calendar to be available to select slots from.
Note: If your company uses Microsoft for business, the highest likelihood is that you have Microsoft 365 – please ensure you select Office 365 from the Cronofy options, not Outlook.com, for example.

Once you have integrated your calendar, you can set your availability for interviews  by going toSettings – Personal – My Preferences.Here you can select your date format, time zone and the days and hours that you wish to be available for interview, in conjunction with your live calendar availability

            Simployer One - Recruitment - Connecting Cronofy to Recruitment

            Modified on Mon, 23 Jun at 10:52 AM

            Connecting Cronofy to Recruitment 

            Simployer Recruitment`s interview scheduling allows you to automate the scheduling of interviews, offering candidates a 1-1 interview, either by phone, video or in-person, or supporting panel style interviews with multiple client-side attendees, or sequential interviews where multiple interviewers take part in a single interview stage as different times, eg ‘Hiring Manager A’ doing 30-mins followed by 45-mins with ‘Hiring Manager B’. 

            The first thing to do to enable automated interview scheduling is to connect to Cronofy, our API which enables us to gather your live calendar availability. 

            To set this up, head to Settings - Integrations - My Integrations. 

            Then, find Cronofy and click Connect. You will be prompted to integrate your individual work email account. You will receive a success message, and the button with show as “Disconnect” once the integration is complete.

            Note: we do not support integration with shared inboxes through Cronofy as this integration requires a personal calendar to be available to select slots from.

            Note: If your company uses Microsoft for business, the highest likelihood is that you have Microsoft 365 – please ensure you select Office 365 from the Cronofy options, not Outlook.com, for example. 

            Once you have integrated your calendar, you can set your availability for interviews  by going to Settings – Personal – My Preferences. Here you can select your date format, time zone and the days and hours that you wish to be available for interview, in conjunction with your live calendar availability

Integrating job boards with Recruitment

At the final stage of creating a job –Sharing– you can also choose to publish the job on a number of job boards.  Currently, you can automatically post your advert to any of the free job sites we are directly integrated with - Adzuna, Jooble, CareerJet and Google Jobs.
Simply toggle on any of the free job boards where you would like your advert to appear:

The advert will then automatically pushed through XML feed to be posted on the job site, and your applicants will appear underAppliedin your job kanban, tracked through to the job board where they arrived. Only Account Owners and Admins can do this for every role, while Job owners can only do this for roles they own.

Note:Once you've toggled these on, it is down to the job board to 'scrape' for new jobs and add to their sites when found. Each job board will 'scrape' at different times, and Recruitment doesn't control this. Generally, it takes 24-72h for the jobs to be posted on the free job boards after they have been added, but this can vary.
Closing a job advert

To close an advert from one of these sites, go toJobsand select the three dots to the right of the job in question. Select “Edit” from and then confirm, then select “Sharing” to get through to the Job Sharing page, where you will be able to disable the toggles and save.
Note:The jobs will not be immediately taken down from these boards but will be removed from the next 'scrape' for jobs which is usually within 24 hours depending on the provider.

            Simployer One - Recruitment - Integrating job boards

            Modified on Mon, 23 Jun at 11:03 AM

            Integrating job boards with Recruitment

            At the final stage of creating a job – Sharing – you can also choose to publish the job on a number of job boards.  Currently, you can automatically post your advert to any of the free job sites we are directly integrated with - Adzuna, Jooble, CareerJet and Google Jobs.

            Simply toggle on any of the free job boards where you would like your advert to appear:

            The advert will then automatically pushed through XML feed to be posted on the job site, and your applicants will appear under Applied in your job kanban, tracked through to the job board where they arrived. Only Account Owners and Admins can do this for every role, while Job owners can only do this for roles they own.

            Note: Once you've toggled these on, it is down to the job board to 'scrape' for new jobs and add to their sites when found. Each job board will 'scrape' at different times, and Recruitment doesn't control this. Generally, it takes 24-72h for the jobs to be posted on the free job boards after they have been added, but this can vary.


            Closing a job advert

            To close an advert from one of these sites, go to Jobs and select the three dots to the right of the job in question. Select “Edit” from and then confirm, then select “Sharing” to get through to the Job Sharing page, where you will be able to disable the toggles and save. 

            Note: The jobs will not be immediately taken down from these boards but will be removed from the next 'scrape' for jobs which is usually within 24 hours depending on the provider.

How to post your jobs to LinkedIn with Simployer Recruitment
There are three ways you can share your job to LinkedIn through Recruitment: LinkedIn company feed post, basic adverts (which are free) or paid adverts.

Note:Depending on your LinkedIn plan, there may be costs associated with adding jobs to your company page - this is something you will be able to handle and manage with LinkedIn and not withRecruitment.
LinkedIn free job posting
To connect your company LinkedIn page, head toSettings - Integrations - Company Integrations.

SelectLinkedIn Jobs Basicin the pop up, and input your Company ID. Your LinkedIn Company ID is a string of numbers, usually 6 to 9 digits long, that is unique to your company. The guidehereexplains where to find this code.
You will then be able to post your jobs to LinkedIn from theSharingstage of job set up - simply toggle onInJobsunderFree Job Boards.
LinkedIn paid job posting
To connect your company LinkedIn page, head toSettings - Integrations - Company Integrations.
SelectLinkedIn Jobs Premiumin the pop up, and input your Company ID. Your LinkedIn Company ID is a string of numbers, usually 6 to 9 digits long, that is unique to your company.
Once your Company ID is entered, clickconnect an accountto authenticate your account and verify yourContract ID(this field will auto-populate).
You will then be able to post your jobs to LinkedIn from theSharingstage of job set up - simply toggle onInJobsunderPaid Job Boards.
Sharing to your LinkedIn company feed
If you're theRecruitmentAccount Owner or an Admin onRecruitment, you can set up a company-level integration with LinkedIn which will enable you to post jobs from your company as a feed post.

Note:The person enabling this integration must have admin access for their company LinkedIn account for jobs to post to these pages and set up this integration. If they are an admin for multiple companies, then the job will post fromallcompanies they are an admin for so we recommend checking this before you go ahead.

To set up this integration, head toSettings - Integrations - Company Integrations. Next to LinkedIn, there is the option to “Connect”.  You'll then be prompted to sign into your LinkedIn account andSave.
You will then be able to toggle LinkedIn on and off at theSharingstage of job.
Note: This LinkedIn integration will not post the job onto the company page. If you wish to post a basic job to your company page, please use the LinkedIn free job postings or Premium jobpostings.

            How to post your jobs to LinkedIn with Simployer Recruitment

            There are three ways you can share your job to LinkedIn through Recruitment: LinkedIn company feed post, basic adverts (which are free) or paid adverts.

            Note: Depending on your LinkedIn plan, there may be costs associated with adding jobs to your company page - this is something you will be able to handle and manage with LinkedIn and not with Recruitment. 


            LinkedIn free job posting

            To connect your company LinkedIn page, head to Settings - Integrations - Company Integrations.

            Select LinkedIn Jobs Basic in the pop up, and input your Company ID. Your LinkedIn Company ID is a string of numbers, usually 6 to 9 digits long, that is unique to your company. The guide here explains where to find this code.

            You will then be able to post your jobs to LinkedIn from the Sharing stage of job set up - simply toggle on InJobs under Free Job Boards. 


            LinkedIn paid job posting 

            To connect your company LinkedIn page, head to Settings - Integrations - Company Integrations.

            Select LinkedIn Jobs Premium in the pop up, and input your Company ID. Your LinkedIn Company ID is a string of numbers, usually 6 to 9 digits long, that is unique to your company. 


            Once your Company ID is entered, click connect an account to authenticate your account and verify your Contract ID (this field will auto-populate).

            You will then be able to post your jobs to LinkedIn from the Sharing stage of job set up - simply toggle on InJobs under Paid Job Boards.


            Sharing to your LinkedIn company feed

            If you're the Recruitment Account Owner or an Admin on Recruitment , you can set up a company-level integration with LinkedIn which will enable you to post jobs from your company as a feed post.

            Note: The person enabling this integration must have admin access for their company LinkedIn account for jobs to post to these pages and set up this integration. If they are an admin for multiple companies, then the job will post from all companies they are an admin for so we recommend checking this before you go ahead.

            To set up this integration, head to Settings - Integrations - Company Integrations. Next to LinkedIn, there is the option to “Connect”.  You'll then be prompted to sign into your LinkedIn account and Save.

            You will then be able to toggle LinkedIn on and off at the Sharing stage of job. 

            Note: This LinkedIn integration will not post the job onto the company page. If you wish to post a basic job to your company page, please use the LinkedIn free job postings or Premium job postings.

Connect Simployer Recruitment to Indeed To connect your company's Indeed page to your Recruitment account, head to Settings - Integrations - Company Integrations and toggle Indeed on. Post a job to Indeed Once you have connected Indeed to your Recruitment account, you will be able to post your jobs to Indeed from the Sharing stage of job set up. Indeed pulls jobs every 4 hours , make sure you have waited long enough. If the job still does not appear on Indeed, you may need to get in touch with your representative at Indeed . There could be a few reasons for Indeed to not show the job on your account, even though they have it. The transferred job from Indeed only becomes available to candidates after they are sponsored. How to post jobs to Indeed with Recruitment (Indeed sponsored jobs)
Learn how to post your jobs into Indeed and make them available to candidates

Note: After you share your job to your company's Indeed account, you need tosponsorthem in order to make them available to candidates. You can read more about sponsored jobs in Indeedon their website.
Connect Simployer Recruitment to Indeed
To connect your company's Indeed page to yourRecruitmentaccount, head toSettings - Integrations - Company Integrationsand toggleIndeedon.
Note: company names are case-sensitive in Indeed.
Post a job to Indeed
Once you have connected Indeed to yourRecruitmentaccount, you will be able to post your jobs to Indeed from theSharingstage of job set up. Simply toggle onIndeedunderPaid Job Boards.

After Indeed pulls job posts (every four hours), your jobs will appear on Indeed as flagged. You need to sponsor them to be available to candidates. To do that, you need to go to the campaign tab on Indeed andcreate a new campaignadding the job that was just transferred.
FAQ
I can not see my job in Indeed, what should I do?

            How to post jobs to Indeed with Recruitment (Indeed sponsored jobs)

            Learn how to post your jobs into Indeed and make them available to candidates

            Note: After you share your job to your company's Indeed account, you need to sponsor them in order to make them available to candidates. You can read more about sponsored jobs in Indeed on their website. 

            Connect Simployer Recruitment to Indeed

            To connect your company's Indeed page to your Recruitment account, head to Settings - Integrations - Company Integrations and toggle Indeed on. 

            • Type in your company name exactly as it appears in Indeed. 

            Note: company names are case-sensitive in Indeed. 

            • If you already have an Indeed Campaign, type it here. Otherwise leave it blank and you can always define it later through Indeed. 

             

            Post a job to Indeed

            Once you have connected Indeed to your Recruitment account, you will be able to post your jobs to Indeed from the Sharing stage of job set up. Simply toggle on Indeed under Paid Job Boards.

            After Indeed pulls job posts (every four hours), your jobs will appear on Indeed as flagged. You need to sponsor them to be available to candidates. To do that, you need to go to the campaign tab on Indeed and create a new campaign adding the job that was just transferred. 

            FAQ 

            I can not see my job in Indeed, what should I do?

            1. Make sure you have entered the correct company name when you first connected to your Indeed account. Company names are case sensitive in Indeed, use lower and upper case as appears on Indeed. 
            2. Indeed pulls jobs every 4 hours, make sure you have waited long enough. 
            3. If the job still does not appear on Indeed, you may need to get in touch with your representative at Indeed. There could be a few reasons for Indeed to not show the job on your account, even though they have it. 
            4. The transferred job from Indeed only becomes available to candidates after they are sponsored. Make sure you create a campaign for the transferred jobs.

All Articles Recent Searches Clear all No recent searches Popular Articles Articles View all Topics View all Tickets View all Sorry! nothing found for Simployer One - Recruitment - Simployer Recruitment apps for Microsoft Teams and email access Modified on Thu, 12 Jun at 12:54 PM Approving Recruitment apps for Microsoft Teams and email access If your organisation’s security settings require you to have an administrator approve access via Microsoft, you may receive an error message when trying to connect via Microsoft, Cronofy (gaining Calendar availability) or Teams. What information do we require In order to make the most of some of Recruitment's automation, we need consent to: Send and receive emails from a user's email account triggered on Recruitment (via the Recruitment App for Email) Help schedule interviews with access to a user's Team calendar to find available interview slots and schedule meetings (via the Recruitment App for Teams) This will only apply to users in an organisation who have access to the reseller’s HR system, a Recruitment account, and have set up these integrations through their Recruitment settings. How to approve Go to Enterprise Applications Under Security , click on Consent & Permissions In the User Consent Settings section: Ensure Allow user consent for apps is selected In the Admin Consent Settings section: Set 'Users can request admin consent to apps they are unable to consent to' to YES Under 'Who can review admin consent requests' , add the users who can review the app Click Save Go to All Applications under 'Manage' Select the App ( Simployer Recruitment App for Teams or Simployer Recruitment App for Email - this process will need to be completed for both) Go to Properties Click the Delete button at the top to remove the application Try to connect again on Recruitment and send the consent request for the App Return to Enterprise Applications Click on Admin consent requests under Activity and approve the app Reconnect the app and you should be good to go! Note: If you have already approved these applications and are still unable to connect, please ask your administrator to revoke consent for both applications and follow this set up guide when re-approving the request to ensure connectivity.             Approving Recruitment apps for Microsoft Teams and email access

            If your organisation’s security settings require you to have an administrator approve access via Microsoft, you may receive an error message when trying to connect via Microsoft, Cronofy (gaining Calendar availability) or Teams.

            What information do we require

            In order to make the most of some of Recruitment's automation, we need consent to:

            • Send and receive emails from a user's email account triggered on Recruitment (via the Recruitment App for Email)
            • Help schedule interviews with access to a user's Team calendar to find available interview slots and schedule meetings (via the Recruitment App for Teams)

            This will only apply to users in an organisation who have access to the reseller’s HR system, a Recruitment account, and have set up these integrations through their Recruitment settings. 

            How to approve

            1. Go to Enterprise Applications
              1. Under Security, click on Consent & Permissions
              2. In the User Consent Settings section:
            1. Ensure Allow user consent for apps is selected

              1. In the Admin Consent Settings section:
            1. Set 'Users can request admin consent to apps they are unable to consent to' to YES

              1. Under 'Who can review admin consent requests', add the users who can review the app
              2. Click Save
            1. Go to All Applications under 'Manage'
              1. Select the App (Simployer Recruitment App for Teams or Simployer Recruitment  App for Email - this process will need to be completed for both)
              2. Go to Properties
              3. Click the Delete button at the top to remove the application
            2. Try to connect again on Recruitment and send the consent request for the App

            1. Return to Enterprise Applications
              1. Click on Admin consent requests under Activity and approve the app
            2. Reconnect the app and you should be good to go!
               

            Note: If you have already approved these applications and are still unable to connect, please ask your administrator to revoke consent for both applications and follow this set up guide when re-approving the request to ensure connectivity.

Generating a Candidate Privacy Policy

As a Recruitment Account Owner, you need to generate a Privacy Policy before you, or anyone else in your company, can publish a job. This is the Privacy Policy which your candidates agree to when they apply to an open job role, ensuring that you are holding their data in a GDPR compliant manner.
To generate a policy for your organisation, go toSettings - Data & Privacy - Privacy Policy.
From here you will need to enter the following mandatory information:
Click 'Generate Policy'so you can preview the populated Privacy Policy. If happy,agree to the Terms and Conditionsand hitsave.
Regenerating a Recruitment Privacy Policy for your organisation

If any of your details change and you need to regenerate a Privacy Policy for your organisation, you can do this by going toSettings - Data & Privacy - Privacy Policyand clicking'Regenerate Policy'in the bottom right hand corner. From here you can follow the process of 'generating a Recruitment Privacy Policy for your organisation'.

            As a Recruitment Account Owner, you need to generate a Privacy Policy before you, or anyone else in your company, can publish a job. This is the Privacy Policy which your candidates agree to when they apply to an open job role, ensuring that you are holding their data in a GDPR compliant manner.

            To generate a policy for your organisation, go to Settings - Data & Privacy - Privacy Policy.

            From here you will need to enter the following mandatory information:

            1. Company Name
            2. Account Owner
            3. Contact Number
            4. Email
            5. Address

            Click 'Generate Policy' so you can preview the populated Privacy Policy. If happy, agree to the Terms and Conditions and hit save.

            Regenerating a Recruitment Privacy Policy for your organisation

            If any of your details change and you need to regenerate a Privacy Policy for your organisation, you can do this by going to Settings - Data & Privacy - Privacy Policy and clicking 'Regenerate Policy' in the bottom right hand corner. From here you can follow the process of 'generating a Recruitment Privacy Policy for your organisation'.

Setting your availability for interviews
Simployer Recruitment's automated interview scheduling allows candidates to book directly into your diary at a time that works for both of you, saving you lots of back and forth.
First, you need to make sure your diary is integrated withRecruitment– you do this onSettings – Integrations – My Integrationsand ensure you have connected the relevant calendar via Cronofy.
You can then set your diary availability underSettings - Personal - My Preferences.

Simply select the days and times you would like to be available for interviews. You can also confirm the date format and time zone you want to use.Recruitmentwill only offer slots within these parameters in conjunction with reviewing your live calendar availability.
You can also set a buffer time between meetings

            Simployer One - Recruitment - Setting your availability for interviews

            Modified on Mon, 23 Jun at 10:56 AM

            Setting your availability for interviews

            Simployer Recruitment's automated interview scheduling allows candidates to book directly into your diary at a time that works for both of you, saving you lots of back and forth.

            First, you need to make sure your diary is integrated with Recruitment – you do this on Settings – Integrations – My Integrations and ensure you have connected the relevant calendar via Cronofy.

            You can then set your diary availability under Settings - Personal - My Preferences.

            Simply select the days and times you would like to be available for interviews. You can also confirm the date format and time zone you want to use. Recruitment will only offer slots within these parameters in conjunction with reviewing your live calendar availability.


            You can also set a buffer time between meetings

Edit your email signature
In Recruitment there are two types of email signature: your personal signature, and your company signature.
Setting your personal email signature
Head toSettings –Personal - My Accountand scroll down to the Email Signature box to add and update a personal email signature.
Note:if you are copying and pasting, please use the CTRL+C and CTRL+V, and ensure you are copying from within the same browser, to ensure logos and HTML to come across correctly.
Setting the Company Email Signature
If you are your company's Account Owner or Admin, you will also be able to set a company signature which will be used on automated emails.
Head toSettings - Company - Profileto see and edit the email signature for the company.
Note:if you are copying and pasting, please use the CTRL+C and CTRL+V, and ensure you are copying from within the same browser, to ensure logos and HTML to come across correctly.

            Edit your email signature

            In Recruitment there are two types of email signature: your personal signature, and your company signature. 

            Setting your personal email signature

            Head to Settings – Personal - My Account and scroll down to the Email Signature box to add and update a personal email signature. 

            Note: if you are copying and pasting, please use the CTRL+C and CTRL+V, and ensure you are copying from within the same browser, to ensure logos and HTML to come across correctly.


            Setting the Company Email Signature

            If you are your company's Account Owner or Admin, you will also be able to set a company signature which will be used on automated emails.

            Head to Settings - Company - Profile to see and edit the email signature for the company. 



            Note: if you are copying and pasting, please use the CTRL+C and CTRL+V, and ensure you are copying from within the same browser, to ensure logos and HTML to come across correctly.

Knowledge base Simployer One Simployer One - Recruitment Simployer One - Recruitment - Creating your career page All Articles Recent Searches Clear all No recent searches Popular Articles Articles View all Topics View all Tickets View all Sorry! nothing found for Simployer One - Recruitment - Creating your career page Modified on Mon, 23 Jun at 10:58 AM Creating your career page Create and customise your careers page Recruitment enables you  to create and customise your own careers site in just a few clicks so that you can easily share your job openings, showcase your employer brand and get candidates excited about what your company offers. As an Account Owner or Admin, you can view and edit your careers site by heading to Settings - Career Site - Customise to get started. When creating and customising your careers site you are able to: Add your company logo Replace imagery Update your text Add, remove and reorder sections Customise your fonts and colours Add company navigation links To add your company's logo at the top of your careers page, head to Edit - Upload your new image - Open. Replacing images To change the images in your careers page, Edit - Upload your new image - Open. From here you'll be asked to crop your images to be optimised for both desktop and mobile. You can zoom in and out to get the fit you are looking for. Note: your images must be less than 5MB. Updating text When you begin with customising your careers site, you'll find we've left some placeholder text and best practices you might want to follow, including the Page Title and 'About Us' section. All of these are editable on page, making it simple to adapt to your company messaging. Adding, removing, and reordering sections You can add more sections from our templates by heading to Settings - Add a section - Hover over the section and click Add. The newly added section will default to the bottom of the page, but can be adjusted to your desired location. If you want to change the order of these sections, you can do this by Settings - Reorder page . You can drag and drop to reorder, and use the “trash” icon to remove a section you no longer need. Changing your fonts and colours You can update the font, colours, and button styles to match your company's brand and style by heading to Settings - Style . If you use a font that we don’t currently offer, or your business has a unique font that isn’t publicly available, we may be able to add for you at a nominal cost. Updating your navigation links You can add or edit your company's social media pages (LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram and more). These can be added under Settings - Navigation Links. You can also add any additional links you would like in either the header or footer of your career page. Preview and publish your careers site When you've added the content of your career page, you can preview it before publishing. To do this, head to Settings in your careers page editor, then Preview . This will open in a new tab for you to review. Publishing your careers site Once you're happy with your preview, you can publish your careers page. To do this, head to Settings in your careers page editor, then Publish . Until you choose to publish the page, it’s not publicly available. Your career page's URL can be found in Settings - Career Site - Settings - Link to careers page . You can copy this URL to use on your website as a redirect from your “Careers” or “Jobs” page Integrating with your existing career page We also offer an API and iFrame giving you flexibility in how you display your live jobs, if you wish to integrate into an existing careers page. Note: you may need support from an IT contact within your organisation to get this integration up and running. iFrame integration The easiest way to integrate is by using the iFrame. Your iFrame code can be found under Settings - Career Site - Settings . This can then be copied, and embedded into your website code base where you would like your vacancies to appear. This will bring up a box that looks similar to the “jobs” section of the career builder on Candidly, where vacancies you post on Recruitment will be displayed if you select 'Make your job visible' at the Sharing stage of job set up. When a prospective applicant clicks on one of the vacancies, they'll be taken through to the apply page that we host on Recruitment for that job, enabling the candidate to submit their application with ease directly into your kanban for your review. The text colour used here can be edited at Settings - Company - Profile - Brand Colour API integration You can also integrate Recruitment with your career page using our API, which allows for greater customisation of how the jobs appear on your site. The API key and documentation can be found under Settings - Integrations - Jobs API . Was this article helpful? No Yes That’s Great! Thank you for your feedback Sorry! Creating your career page
Create and customise your careers page

Recruitment enables you  to create and customise your own careers site in just a few clicks so that you can easily share your job openings, showcase your employer brand and get candidates excited about what your company offers.As an Account Owner or Admin, you can view and edit your careers site by heading toSettings - Career Site - Customiseto get started.
When creating and customising your careers site you are able to:
To add your company's logo at the top of your careers page, head toEdit - Upload your new image - Open.
Replacing images
To change the images in your careers page,Edit - Upload your new image - Open.
From here you'll be asked to crop your images to be optimised for both desktop and mobile. You can zoom in and out to get the fit you are looking for.
Note: your images must be less than 5MB.
Updating text

When you begin with customising your careers site, you'll find we've left some placeholder text and best practices you might want to follow, including thePage Titleand'About Us'section. All of these are editable on page, making it simple to adapt to your company messaging.
Adding, removing, and reordering sections

You can add more sections from our templates by heading toSettings - Add a section - Hover over the section and click Add.The newly added section will default to the bottom of the page, but can be adjusted to your desired location.
If you want to change the order of these sections, you can do this bySettings - Reorder page. You can drag and drop to reorder, and use the “trash” icon to remove a section you no longer need.
Changing your fonts and colours

You can update the font, colours, and button styles to match your company's brand and style by heading toSettings - Style. If you use a font that we don’t currently offer, or your business has a unique font that isn’t publicly available, we may be able to add for you at a nominal cost.
Updating your navigation links
You can add or edit your company's social media pages (LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram and more). These can be added underSettings - Navigation Links.
You can also add any additional links you would like in either the header or footer of your career page.
Preview and publish your careers site
When you've added the content of your career page, you can preview it before publishing. To do this, head toSettingsin your careers page editor, thenPreview.
This will open in a new tab for you to review.
Publishing your careers site

Once you're happy with your preview, you can publish your careers page. To do this, head toSettingsin your careers page editor, thenPublish. Until you choose to publish the page, it’s not publicly available.
Your career page's URL can be found inSettings - Career Site - Settings - Link to careers page. You can copy this URL to use on your website as a redirect from your “Careers” or “Jobs” page
Integrating with your existing career page
We also offer an API and iFrame giving you flexibility in how you display your live jobs, if you wish to integrate into an existing careers page.
Note: you may need support from an IT contact within your organisation to get this integration up and running.
iFrame integration

The easiest way to integrate is by using the iFrame. Your iFrame code can be found underSettings - Career Site - Settings. This can then be copied, and embedded into your website code base where you would like your vacancies to appear.

This will bring up a box that looks similar to the “jobs” section of the career builder on Candidly, where vacancies you post on Recruitment will be displayed if you select 'Make your job visible' at theSharingstage of job set up. When a prospective applicant clicks on one of the vacancies, they'll be taken through to the apply page that we host onRecruitmentfor that job, enabling the candidate to submit their application with ease directly into your kanban for your review.
The text colour used here can be edited atSettings - Company - Profile - Brand Colour
API integration
You can also integrateRecruitmentwith your career page using our API, which allows for greater customisation of how the jobs appear on your site.
The API key and documentation can be found underSettings - Integrations - Jobs API.

            Simployer One - Recruitment - Creating your career page

            Modified on Mon, 23 Jun at 10:58 AM

            Creating your career page


            Create and customise your careers page

            Recruitment enables you  to create and customise your own careers site in just a few clicks so that you can easily share your job openings, showcase your employer brand and get candidates excited about what your company offers.
             
            As an Account Owner or Admin, you can view and edit your careers site by heading to Settings - Career Site - Customise to get started.

            When creating and customising your careers site you are able to:

            • Add your company logo
            • Replace imagery
            • Update your text
            • Add, remove and reorder sections
            • Customise your fonts and colours
            • Add company navigation links 

            To add your company's logo at the top of your careers page, head to Edit - Upload your new image - Open.

            Replacing images

            To change the images in your careers page, Edit - Upload your new image - Open.

            From here you'll be asked to crop your images to be optimised for both desktop and mobile. You can zoom in and out to get the fit you are looking for.

            Note: your images must be less than 5MB.

            Updating text

            When you begin with customising your careers site, you'll find we've left some placeholder text and best practices you might want to follow, including the Page Title and 'About Us' section. All of these are editable on page, making it simple to adapt to your company messaging.

            Adding, removing, and reordering sections

            You can add more sections from our templates by heading to Settings - Add a section - Hover over the section and click Add. The newly added section will default to the bottom of the page, but can be adjusted to your desired location.

             

            If you want to change the order of these sections, you can do this by Settings - Reorder page. You can drag and drop to reorder, and use the “trash” icon to remove a section you no longer need.

            Changing your fonts and colours

            You can update the font, colours, and button styles to match your company's brand and style by heading to Settings - Style. If you use a font that we don’t currently offer, or your business has a unique font that isn’t publicly available, we may be able to add for you at a nominal cost.

            Updating your navigation links

            You can add or edit your company's social media pages (LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram and more). These can be added under Settings - Navigation Links.

            You can also add any additional links you would like in either the header or footer of your career page.

            Preview and publish your careers site

            When you've added the content of your career page, you can preview it before publishing. To do this, head to Settings in your careers page editor, then Preview.

            This will open in a new tab for you to review.

            Publishing your careers site

            Once you're happy with your preview, you can publish your careers page. To do this, head to Settings in your careers page editor, then Publish. Until you choose to publish the page, it’s not publicly available.

            Your career page's URL can be found in Settings - Career Site - Settings - Link to careers page. You can copy this URL to use on your website as a redirect from your “Careers” or “Jobs” page

            Integrating with your existing career page

            We also offer an API and iFrame giving you flexibility in how you display your live jobs, if you wish to integrate into an existing careers page. 

            Note: you may need support from an IT contact within your organisation to get this integration up and running.

             

            iFrame integration

            The easiest way to integrate is by using the iFrame. Your iFrame code can be found under Settings - Career Site - Settings. This can then be copied, and embedded into your website code base where you would like your vacancies to appear.

            This will bring up a box that looks similar to the “jobs” section of the career builder on Candidly, where vacancies you post on Recruitment will be displayed if you select 'Make your job visible' at the Sharing stage of job set up. When a prospective applicant clicks on one of the vacancies, they'll be taken through to the apply page that we host on Recruitment for that job, enabling the candidate to submit their application with ease directly into your kanban for your review. 

            The text colour used here can be edited at Settings - Company - Profile - Brand Colour

            API integration

            You can also integrate Recruitment with your career page using our API, which allows for greater customisation of how the jobs appear on your site.

            The API key and documentation can be found under Settings - Integrations - Jobs API.

Account Owners can: Add and remove other users and determine permission levels (please check the specifics of the integration with the HRIS partner which may impact where user provisioning is selected) Complete the key setup tasks for their account, such as creating the privacy Policy and setting up a career page Access all other product features at Admin-level Admins can: Manage all jobs & candidates Customise their careers page View all reports (account-wide) Adjust and manage default templates and create custom templates Manage team and overall agency permissions, as well as company-level integrations Users can: Manage jobs they created, including candidates that were involved in them Enable personal profile integrations, but not company level ones View templates and create/edit custom templates Access all other product features at Reviewer-level Reviewers can: View jobs that have been assigned to them – they can’t create a job Participate in interviews Fill in scorecards for candidates in jobs they are part of the hiring team for Receive relevant notifications in the Communication Centre (same as all permission levels) Note: the best way to view this is that admins have full visibility of everything across all users, users have full visibility for all jobs they are involved in, and reviewer level have the lowest permission, only being able to respond to actions required within the jobs they are added to the hiring team for – eg. completing a scorecard or leaving a note against a candidate Was this article helpful?             User Roles

            There are four main permission levels in Recruitment - Account Owner, Admin, User and Reviewer.

            Account Owners can:

            • Add and remove other users and determine permission levels (please check the specifics of the integration with the HRIS partner which may impact where user provisioning is selected)
            • Complete the key setup tasks for their account, such as creating the privacy Policy and setting up a career page
            • Access all other product features at Admin-level

             

            Admins can:

            • Manage all jobs & candidates 
            • Customise their careers page
            • View all reports (account-wide)
            • Adjust and manage default templates and create custom templates
            • Manage team and overall agency permissions, as well as company-level integrations

             

            Users can:

            • Manage jobs they created, including candidates that were involved in them
            • Enable personal profile integrations, but not company level ones
            • View templates and create/edit custom templates
            • Access all other product features at Reviewer-level

             

            Reviewers can:

            • View jobs that have been assigned to them – they can’t create a job
            • Participate in interviews
            • Fill in scorecards for candidates in jobs they are part of the hiring team for
            • Receive relevant notifications in the Communication Centre (same as all permission levels)


            Note: the best way to view this is that admins have full visibility of everything across all users, users have full visibility for all jobs they are involved in, and reviewer level have the lowest permission, only being able to respond to actions required within the jobs they are added to the hiring team for – eg. completing a scorecard or leaving a note against a candidate
